description: Na₆Ti₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.34 Å. Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-70°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.92 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra.
